#Proteomics-specific helper functions (can move later)
makeBoxplot <- function(tab, grp, grp.col, grp.col.leg, main, legend=T, cex.lab=1, mar=c(4,12,2,4)){
  
  cat('\n-- makeBoxplot --\n')
  at.vec=1:ncol(tab)
  ##########################################
  ## plot
  par(mar=mar)
  boxplot(tab, pch=".", col='white', outline=T, horizontal=T, las=2, xlab="expression", border=grp.col, at=at.vec, axes=F, main=main,xlim=c(0, ifelse(legend, ncol(tab)+2, ncol(tab)) ))
  ##legend('top', legend=names(grp.col.leg), ncol=2, bty='n', border = names(grp.col.leg), fill='white', cex=1.5)
  if(legend)
    legend('top', legend=names(grp.col.leg), ncol=length(grp.col.leg), bty='n', border = grp.col.leg, fill=grp.col.leg, cex=cex.lab)
  ##legend('top', legend=c(input$label.g1, input$label.g2), ncol=2, bty='n', border = c('grey10', 'darkblue'), fill='white', cex=1.5, lwd=3)
  mtext( paste('N=',unlist(apply(tab,2, function(x)sum(!is.na(x)))), sep=''), at=at.vec, side=4, las=2, adj=0, cex.lab=cex.lab)
  axis(1)
  axis(2, at=at.vec, labels=colnames(tab), las=2, cex=cex.lab)
  
  cat('\n-- makeBoxplot exit --\n')
}

my.col2rgb <- function(color, alpha=80, maxColorValue=255){
  
  out <- vector( "character", length(color) )
  
  for(col in 1:length(color)){
    
    col.rgb <- col2rgb(color[col])
    
    out[col] <- rgb(col.rgb[1], col.rgb[2], col.rgb[3], alpha=alpha, maxColorValue=maxColorValue)
    
  }
  return(out)
}

1. Data import, median-normalization, and basic QC

Loading data and metadata, median-normalization

#Loading BIC vial_metadata file from GCP (tmt_plex/channel assignments)
BIC_meta <- "gs://motrpac-data-hub/human-precovid/results/proteomics-untargeted/t07-adipose/prot-ph/motrpac_human-precovid_t07-adipose_prot-ph_vial-metadata_v1.0.txt"

tmt_metadata <- 
  MotrpacBicQC::dl_read_gcp(
    path=BIC_meta,
    tmpdir= "../data",
    gsutil_path = config$gsutil_user, 
    ignore_std_err = FALSE) %>% data.frame()

names(tmt_metadata)[names(tmt_metadata) == "vial_label"] = "vialLabel"

#Loading EQC pheno data from GCP, merging with vial_metadata
EQC <- load_pheno_v5()
pheno <- EQC$pheno_data
meta_merge <- left_join(tmt_metadata, pheno)

#Filtering out HA subjects
meta_merge <- subset(meta_merge, meta_merge$protocol == "01")

meta_merge$id <- meta_merge$vialLabel

#making concatenated group-timepoint variable
meta_merge$group_timepoint <- paste0(meta_merge$randomGroupCode,"_", meta_merge$Timepoint)

#converting clinical site to nominal variable
meta_merge$clinical_site <- as.character(meta_merge$clinical_site)

#loading in proteome data
BIC_phos <- "gs://motrpac-data-hub/human-precovid/results/proteomics-untargeted/t07-adipose/prot-ph/motrpac_human-precovid_t07-adipose_prot-ph_ratio-results_v1.0.txt"

phos <-
  MotrpacBicQC::dl_read_gcp(
    path = BIC_phos,
    tmpdir = "../data",
    gsutil_path = config$gsutil_user,
    ignore_std_err = FALSE
  ) %>% data.frame()

#removing duplicated proteins and contaminants in the ratio_results data
phos <- phos[!duplicated(phos$ptm_id),]
phos <- phos %>% filter(phos$is_contaminant == "FALSE")

#generating data matrix
mat <- phos %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("X"))

#removing Xs from colnames
names(mat)=str_sub(names(mat),2)

#Filter proteomics data to just the SED samples in metadata file
mat <- mat[,colnames(mat) %in% meta_merge$vialLabel]
mat <- as.matrix(mat)

#generating row information for GCT later
rdesc <- phos %>% dplyr::select(!starts_with("X"))
rdesc <- rdesc %>% dplyr::select(!starts_with("pool"))
rdesc$id <- rdesc$ptm_id

#building GCT
rownames(mat) <- rdesc$ptm_id
cdesc <- meta_merge
cdesc <- cdesc[match(colnames(mat),cdesc$vialLabel),]
cdesc$id <- as.character(cdesc$id)
if(ncol(mat)!=nrow(cdesc)|nrow(mat)!=nrow(rdesc)){
  stop("Column or row annotations do not match 
             the matrix size.")}

#this is non-batch effect corrected, non-normalized dataset
phos_nonnorm <- GCT(mat=mat, 
                        rdesc=rdesc, 
                        cdesc=cdesc, 
                        rid =rownames(mat), 
                        cid = colnames(mat))

#This is non-batch effect corrected, median-normalized dataset
phos_mednorm <- phos_nonnorm %>% median_mad_norm(F)

QC: Feature IDs by plex/ sample

IDs_by_plex <- function(x){
  df <- data.frame()
  for(i in unique(x@cdesc$tmt_plex)) {
    data <- subset_gct(x, cid = which(x@cdesc$tmt_plex == i))
    md <- data@cdesc
    data <- data.frame(data@mat)
    data <- data[rowSums(is.na(data)) != ncol(data),]
    data <- data.frame(nrow(data))
    data$tmt_plex <- i
    df <- rbind(df, data)
    
  }
  colnames(df) = c("ptm_IDs", "tmt_plex")
  
  # print(ggplot(data = df) + geom_histogram(mapping = aes(x = tmt_plex, y = protein_IDs, fill = tmt_plex), stat = "identity") + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()))
  # 
  print(ggplot(data = df) + geom_bar(mapping = aes(reorder(tmt_plex, ptm_IDs), y= ptm_IDs, fill = tmt_plex), stat = "identity") + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) + xlab("tmt_plex") )
  
}

IDs_by_sample <- function(GCT) {
  
  df <- data.frame(GCT@mat)
  df <- data.frame(GCT@mat)
  df <- sapply(df, function(x) sum(!is.na(x)))
  test <- data.frame(df)
  test$sample <- rownames(test)
  colnames(test) <- c("ptm_IDs", "vialLabel")
  rownames(test) = NULL
  test$vialLabel <- str_sub(test$vialLabel, 2)
  test <- left_join(test, GCT@cdesc, by = "vialLabel")
  
  # print(ggplot(data = test) + geom_histogram(mapping = aes(x = id, y = protein_IDs, fill = tmt_plex), stat = "identity") + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) )
  
  print(ggplot(data = test) + geom_bar(mapping = aes(reorder(vialLabel, ptm_IDs), y= ptm_IDs, fill = tmt_plex), stat = "identity") + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) + xlab("id") )
  
}

IDs_by_plex(x = phos_nonnorm)

IDs_by_sample(GCT = phos_nonnorm)
